text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Sev2: kv-cache write amplification + continuous-batching latency spike in us-west-2. Observed: cache miss rate jump, batching lat p50/p95 increase, multiple 5xxs on streaming endpoints. Auto-posting here for on-call.
carla: I'm the on-call. looking at the metrics now — kv-shard-7 shows key churn surge and per-token throughput drop. Beginning cross-checks with deploys. @dave do you see any recent pushes to schema-encoder?

dave: yep, pushed schema-encoder v2.3 ~15m before the pager. It now emits structured arrays for tool/function calls (more nested arrays + variable-length keys). Hypothesis: structured output changed prefix patterns, causing prefix-based prefix-KV caching to miss and explode cache entries. Miss rate: 7.8% -> 63.2% on shard-7. Batching fragmentation: avg batch size fell from 24 -> 7.

alice: confirmed logs show lots of tiny shard writes, and eviction pressure rising. Example log excerpt (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T17:10:05Z batcher[shard=7] WARN kvcache: put key "pref:toolcall:arr:[...long-var]" size=512 eviction_score=0.98
2026-03-15T17:10:06Z batcher[shard=7] ERR serve: stream write timeout id=abc123 svc=/v1/generate
```

emily: any customer impact yet? need list for status page and CS.

carla: two customers seeing elevated 504s and retries: acme-inc and fastshop. Error rate for those routes up ~6% for last 10m. Starting customer impact note.

alice: mitigation options: 1) revert schema-encoder v2.3 (deploy rollback) 2) temporary runtime config to disable structured-output prefetch/prefixing so keys stay stable 3) emergency route to model variant that doesn't emit structured arrays. Revert is safest long-term but higher blast radius for other regions. Recommend quick runtime toggle + targeted route update as immediate hotfix.

carla: agree. I'll apply toggle first. Pushing runtime config patch to batchers in us-west-2:

```bash
# turn off structured prefetch/prefixing in runtime config
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/runtime-configs/us-west-2 \
  -d '{"schema_output.prefetch": false, "schema_output.prefixing": false}'

# trigger rolling restart of batcher pool
redwoodctl fleet restart --pool batcher-usw2 --grace 30s
```

alice: applying now. patch accepted (200). initiating rolling restart on 8 nodes.

opsbot: rollout started for pool=batcher-usw2. node-1 -> node-3 restarted (3/8).

carla: looking at live metrics — cache miss rate falling on shard-7 (63% -> 28% after first 3 nodes). batch size recovering: 7 -> 15 p50. latency p95 still elevated but trending down.

dave: I'm also opening a quick traffic rule to route funcall-heavy routes to model=v1-lite-no-struct for known customers to reduce pressure:
```yaml
# ephemeral route patch
routes:
  - match: ["/v1/generate", {header: "x-tenant", value: "acme-inc"}]
    override_model: v1-lite-no-struct
    ttl: 30m
```
Applying now.

emily: putting a short status update on status.redwood.io: "Investigating increased errors in us-west-2 affecting streaming and toolcall responses. Mitigations in progress." Also notifying CS to reach out to affected customers.

alice: restart finished (8/8). post-roll metrics: shard-7 miss 63% -> 12.4% over 10m, batch size avg 22, p95 latency back to near-baseline. 5xxs dropping.

carla: confirming customer error rates returning to baseline. acme-inc 5xxs down from 6% -> 0.4% in last 5m. fastshop similar. tagging this as partially mitigated.

dave: action items immediate: revert schema change with a follow-up validated rollout if we want v2.3, but only after we add deterministic key prefixing or normalized structured-output hashing. Also add a canary that exercises structured arrays on small traffic before global rollout.

alice: I'll open hotfix PR to the encoder that adds stable key normalization and a feature flag to gate variable-length arrays.

carla: on-call handoff in 30m to emily for post-incident monitoring and follow-up. emily, please own the customer comms and the postmortem.

emily: taking handoff. I'll coordinate with product on schema backward-compat checks and add a regression test in the eval harness to detect cache blowups from schema churn.

incident-bot: Note: pager escalations suppressed. Incident marked: PARTIALLY_MITIGATED. Followups created: #INC-4672 (postmortem), #OPS-911 (schema regression test), #CONFIG-220 (runtime feature flag).

carla: thanks team. adding brief timeline to the incident doc and then handoff to @emily. If any residual anomalies spike, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
